lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical line segments are visible across the torso. Spacing between lines is wider in the anterior section (shoulder/mid-flank) and becomes significantly narrower in the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 10, 11, and 12 (counting from anterior) show distinct vertical breaks or termination before reaching the ventral region. Lines near the pelvic junction are composed of fragmented, dash-like segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 9 high-contrast white circular spots is located on the posterior flank and upper hind limb, concentrated primarily in the lower haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: A white chevron-shaped band is present across the bridge of the muzzle. Two distinct white circular spots are visible on the lower cheek area. White horizontal bands are visible on the inner and outer surfaces of the hind limbs.
